dogecoin.text:
He scrolls through chaos, his heart beats fast,
“Did I rename Twitter to ‘X’ at last?
Or sell Mars plots for Dogecoin stock?
Did I promise free Teslas for every TikTok?”

Let Elon rule the world—sure, everyone gets free Wi-Fi, but only if you relocate to Mars. Earth becomes a Tesla showroom, traffic jams are replaced with SpaceX launch queues, and your rent is due in Dogecoin. Meanwhile, Neuralink ensures you think you’re happy. #madmusk
